name: cache-money
description: Run this workflow from Codex. Keep the Anthropic prompt cache warm during Claude Code sessions — especially during peak hours when usage limits are tighter. Detects your cache TTL (5-min default or 1-hour extended) and schedules pings accordingly, reducing token costs by up to 90% on cached context.
